pages.text: Forging the $(item)Rainbow Chalk$() is a service provided by an $(#AA00AA)Eldritch Spirit$().$(br)This chalk can replace any chalk, with extra features.$(br)1. Use a $(item)Spirit Attuned Gem$() to toggle the random color changes or$(br)use any dye to set the color of $()

glyph, items will not be consumed.$(br)2. Use this chalk in a glyph while crouched will erase the glyph, acting as a $(item)Chalk Brush$().$(br)3. Hold a dye in your other hand to define the color when placing the glyph.$(br)

Forging the $(item)Void Chalk$() is a service provided by an $(#AA00AA)Eldritch Spirit$().$(br)This chalk has the same abilities as the $(item)Rainbow Chalk$()$(br) but the color flickering is white to black.$(br)
